original_en:
Continue to the title screen
and select New Game to start
another quest with a higher
difficulty level.
The difficulty level will increase
each time you beat the game.
Note that if you reset or
turn your console off
before selecting New Game,
the difficulty will not change. <PART> @ <PART> ATo Title Screen
